prompts.name: ultramarines
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PRODUCTION ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for a Windows desktop pet, not a mockup. Create one square 2048x2048 PNG sprite atlas on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows of equally sized 512x512 cells, 16 full-body poses of the SAME armored soldier, one centered in each cell with clear empty margins. NO text, no labels, no grid lines, no floor/background, no cast shadow, no duplicated characters in a cell. Entire weapons, boots and backpack always inside their own cell, no overlap. Same camera, same character size, same head shape, same armor detailing across all 16 cells. Face and weapons always point RIGHT, slight three-quarter side view, a recognizable Space Marine from Warhammer 40,000, realistic heroic proportions 5.5-6 heads tall, NOT chibi, NOT toy, not cartoon flat vector. Professional hand-pixelled game sprite aesthetics: deliberately crisp square pixel clusters, selective dark outline, controlled limited palettes, bright edge highlights, dark occlusion beneath plates, worn chipped ceramite, scratches, rivets, tiny purity seals, ribbed flexible joints, detailed boots and bolter, believable metal volume, no soft airbrushed shading, no smooth vector look. Pixel clusters roughly 3-4 source pixels wide (logical sprite about 100 pixels tall) so it reads as fine pixel art when displayed 190 pixels high. Strong heavy silhouette with large pauldrons, compact power pack, small helmet with glowing eye slit. All standing characters' boots align with cell baseline y=458; normal standing body from y=80 to458. Keep scale consistent, running legs can bend but don't change body size. Reading order across rows:
cells 0,1: relaxed idle, then subtle breathing/weapon inspection.
cells 2-9: eight consecutive running-cycle frames, full distinct strides with contact/down/passing/up twice, cradling weapon; feet and legs change convincingly, upper body steady.
cells 10-15: SIX successive attack poses specified below. Animation must be visibly different between poses and remain anatomically coherent.
CHAPTER / ARMOR / WEAPON: ULTRAMARINES: cobalt blue armor with warm antique gold trims, white omega chapter symbol, small red glowing eye lenses, compact worn black and gunmetal bolter rifle held in both hands. ATTACK cells10-15: 10 plants feet and raises bolter; 11 carefully aims rifle perfectly horizontally right; 12 fires, bright compact yellow muzzle star to right; 13 braced recoil rifle slightly up with tiny brass casing; 14 second shot rifle level; 15 lowers rifle to relaxed recovery. Standing pixels must remain aligned between these frames. Transparent PNG alpha, not a checkerboard painted into background.

prompts.name: raven-guard
prompts.prompt: Create a production-ready 4x4 animation sprite atlas, EXACTLY SIXTEEN full-body sprites in FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and FOUR EQUAL ROWS. Transparent alpha PNG background (no checkerboard, no color background). Each of the sixteen equal square cells contains ONE whole Raven Guard Warhammer 40K marine facing right with plenty of empty margin; no figure crosses a cell edge. Detailed pixel realism: black battle-worn armor, cold grey-blue edge highlights, white raven shoulder symbol, beaked helmet with tiny red eyes, ragged black feather cape, silver lightning-claw blades. Small realistic helmet, heavy shoulders, 5.5-head body proportions. Crisp pixel clusters, no soft illustration shading. Same character and scale in all cells, feet at same baseline except crouches. ROW ONE exactly 4: idle, weapon inspection, run left contact, run left passing. ROW TWO exactly 4: run left up, run right contact, run right passing, run right up. ROW THREE exactly 4: run left contact, run left passing, crouching preparation, claws pulled back windup. ROW FOUR exactly 4: lunging stab right, diagonal upward claw rake, low reverse slash, standing recovered. Repeat: final row MUST contain only FOUR sprites at same four column positions as every other row. No labels, no extra sprites, no shadows, no grid lines. All negative space is truly transparent.
